title: AI Techlead
description:
At a glance
Our AI team builds GenAI applications that go into production at one of the Netherlands' largest banks. Voice agents handling thousands of contact center calls. AI lending assistants supporting lenders in writing credit proposals. Agentic workflows that actually make it to users.
We don't stop at prototypes. We build, ship, measure, iterate, and do it fast. As an
AI Tech Lead
, you set the technical direction across these initiatives and stay close enough to the code to keep that pace honest. If you've got 7+ years of engineering experience, a serious track record of shipping AI in production, and you're looking to lead at a scale most companies won't give you for years, read on.
Your job
You set the technical direction on GenAI initiatives that span the bank: from the first conversation with a business team through to production and beyond. You decide how things get built, you build with the team, and you make sure the right things actually get done in a complex organisation. Your focus shifts with the use case: backend, frontend, from levering LLM’s to agentic. You own outcomes, not just architecture diagrams. You work directly with the people whose problems you're solving, and you bring the rest of the team along.
Concretely, you'll:
Set the technical direction for GenAI solutions across banking use cases: Voice AI, RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, document intelligence.
Drive initiatives end-to-end through a complex organisation: align stakeholders, unblock teams, make the calls that need to be made.
Co-create use cases with business counterparts: you understand the problem, not just the technology, and you shape what gets built.
Stay hands-on: design and write the hard parts if required.
Own architecture and technical quality across multiple workstreams: trade-offs, patterns, what we standardise on, what we don't.
Work with Agents, plain LLMs, code, Databricks and whatever the right tool is for the job.
Raise the technical bar of the team: code reviews, design reviews, knowledge sharing, coaching mediors and juniors.
Working environment
You'll be part of a 25+ person AI team inside ABN AMRO's Innovation department. We operate with a startup mindset within a bank that serves millions of customers and employs thousands of individuals: fast feedback loops, direct lines to business leadership, and real deployment at scale. Amsterdam, hybrid.
Your profile
We don't hire on CV titles. We hire on what you've shipped and what you've led. The team includes people who came through software engineering, data science, infra — what they share is proven AI expertise and a bias for building over theorising. As a tech lead, you bring the same plus the ability to take an ambiguous problem and a group of strong engineers and turn it into something running in production.
What you've done:
Led the technical side of AI or software initiatives end-to-end: you've owned the architecture, made the hard calls, and shipped.
Built and deployed AI applications using LLMs, RAG, agents, fine-tuning, voice AI, or equivalent (at production scale, with real users).
Written Python that runs in production: you're a developer, not a notebook user, and you still enjoy writing the code.
Worked with cloud infrastructure: Azure preferred, AWS or GCP also fine.
Operated inside a complex organisation (or built the muscle elsewhere) and got things done across teams, not just within one.
How you work:
You take ambiguous problems, set a direction, and bring people with you (without waiting for permission).
You have strong technical opinions, formed through experience, and you're willing to defend them and change them.
You're as interested in the business problem as in the technical solution.
You explain your decisions clearly to people who don't share your context (engineers, business, leadership).
You follow the GenAI field closely because you're genuinely curious, not because you have to.
You've built something on the side (a tool, a project, a contribution) that shows you don't wait to be told what to learn.
We are offering
We believe it is important to be a good employer. Joining us means stepping into a role with impact, supported by excellent employment conditions that foster your job satisfaction, development, and wellbeing. In addition, we offer:
An attractive gross monthly salary based on a 36‑hour work week, including holiday allowance and a flexible benefit budget which adds up to a range of €65.000 to €93.000 a year based on a 36-hour week (40 hours possible, pro-rated)
An excellent pension scheme, ensuring that you are well prepared for the future.
Flexibility in working: working from home is possible in consultation with your team and depending on your role. We will provide an ergonomic home office setup for you.
Plenty of room for relaxation with five weeks of vacation per year, supplemented by two mandatory days off. You can also purchase up to four additional weeks of vacation annually.
Five “Banking for better days”: extra days off that you can use for personal development or volunteer work.
Personal development is key: you receive a development budget of €1,000 per year, which can accumulate up to €3,000.
An annual public transport pass with free public transportation throughout the Netherlands for both business and private use.
You can find more information about our employment conditions and salary scales in our Collective Labour Agreement (CLA), which applies to this vacancy.
Interested?
No motivation letter. Please answer these two questions instead:
Tell us about an AI initiative you led: what did you build, what calls did you make as the technical lead, and what did you learn when it hit production (or real users)?
What's the most interesting thing you've built or experimented with in AI in the last six months? Why does it matter to you?
Applications without these answers will not be reviewed.
The recruitmentprocess consists of an online personality assessment, an online culture interview, a technical case and an offline technical Interview.
Your Future: Inclusive, Innovative, Sustainable
At ABN AMRO, we believe in "
Banking for better, for generations to come.
" Equal opportunities for everyone are a crucial foundation, as we strive for an inclusive culture where all employees feel seen, heard, and valued. Our vision of
being a personal bank in the digital age
aligns perfectly with the demand for surprising insights and innovative solutions, born from a diverse interplay of cultures and experiences. We focus on customer experience, sustainability, and building a future-proof bank, conducting annual reviews to ensure equal pay for equal work. Join a bank that embraces ingenuity and ambition, and make an impact with us for a better future.

title: Data Driven Cyber Security Analyst
description:
At a glance
Join CISO Cyber Defence – protecting ABN AMRO’s future!
At CISO Cyber Defence, we are driven by a bold ambition: to deliver world-class cyber resilience for ABN AMRO, safeguarding our organization and clients in an ever-evolving digital landscape. To achieve this, we are embarking on an exciting journey to revolutionize our cybersecurity approach. We are implementing a cutting-edge, data-driven analytic framework that provides clear, actionable insights by visualizing security gaps using a comprehensive set of metrics. These powerful insights empower our team to make strategic, data-driven decisions to continuously elevate ABN AMRO’s cyber resilience to new heights.
Become part of a passionate team dedicated to protecting what matters most. Together, let’s shape the future of cybersecurity and innovation at ABN AMRO.
Your job
Become a Data-Driven Cyber Security Analyst at CISO Cyber Defence – make an impact where it matters most!
Are you ready to play a pivotal role in shaping the future of cybersecurity at ABN AMRO? As a Data-Driven Cyber Security Analyst within CISO Cyber Defence, you will drive the implementation of an advanced, data-driven analytic framework, setting the standard for identifying and visualizing security gaps. Your expertise will empower CISO Cyber Defence to make smarter, more informed decisions on how and where to strengthen the bank’s cyber resilience.
By leveraging metrics and generating actionable insights, you will not only uncover vulnerabilities but also transform data into impactful, evidence-based solutions that directly enhance security. In this role, you will ensure that the organization’s time, budget, and efforts are invested strategically—delivering measurable improvements to our cybersecurity posture and raising the value delivered by Cyber Defence.
Join us and become a key player in safeguarding ABN AMRO’s future in the digital world!
Working environment
Join the Cyber Insighters – a team that turns data into actionable security innovation!
Step into an exciting opportunity as part of a brand-new team called "Cyber Insighters"! This dynamic, diverse, and international group is comprised of a Product Owner, Data-Driven Cyber Security Analysts, Data Analysts, and Developers, all working together to redefine cybersecurity at ABN AMRO. Based in Amstelveen, the Cyber Insighters team thrives on collaboration and innovation, with English as the primary language. Representing a variety of countries and cultures, the team embodies the spirit of inclusivity and creativity.
Our ambition is simple yet powerful: “Think big, but start small!” By combining forward-thinking ideas with data-driven insights, we aim to deliver impactful solutions that elevate ABN AMRO’s cyber resilience.
Are you ready to join a team where big dreams and small steps lead to meaningful change? Let’s make it happen together!
Your profile
Key Responsibilities – make an impact in cyber resilience!
As a Data-Driven Cyber Security Analyst, you will play a crucial role in enhancing ABN AMRO’s cyber resilience. Your key responsibilities include:
Innovating Threat Models: Design and refine advanced quantitative threat-modelling algorithms for the Cyber Resilience Index (CRI) to identify and address vulnerabilities.
Building Smarter Metrics: Develop and enhance the Security Metrics Framework (SMF) by integrating new data sources and improving data quality.
Delivering Actionable Insights: Generate statistical estimates for challenging security metrics, transforming them into clear, data-driven decision-making tools.
Driving High-Impact Initiatives: Analyse CRI and SMF outputs continuously to recommend and monitor high-ROI security strategies.
Empowering Stakeholders: Lead engaging demos and hands-on workshops, educating teams on the value of evidence-based security solutions.
Collaborating for Success: Work closely with the data engineering team to implement your models into production pipelines and ensure quality through code and data model reviews.
Must-Have Expertise – what we’re looking for
Experience: 5+ years in cybersecurity, with a strong focus on data science.
Certifications: While not mandatory, certifications such as CISSP, GIAC/SANS (e.g., GDSA, GICSP), or similar are highly valued.
Cyber-threat & risk modelling: Deep familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK, D3FEND, CAPEC, CVE/CVSS, NIST, CIS Benchmarks and Microsoft Security Benchmark.
Security: Knows how modern EDR/XDR suites work, can evaluate efficacy of controls and telemetry coverage. Microsoft Defender stack, Azure services, network-security fundamentals.
Nice-to-Haves – additional skills that make you stand out
Hands-on experience with PowerBI, Databricks, and Detection Engineering tools.
Quantitative analysis & statistics: Comfortable with statistical methods, confidence intervals and Monte-Carlo & Bayesian approaches.
Data tooling: Python (data/ML stack), SQL and KQL. Able to wrangle large and dynamic data sets.
Conceptual languages: ArchiMate.
Are you ready to lead, innovate, and make a measurable impact on cybersecurity at ABN AMRO? Join us and take your career to the next level!

Working at ABN AMRO means contributing to a better future for yourself and society. We offer you the space to innovate and grow, with access to a variety of career opportunities and development programs. You’ll work in an inspiring and collaborative environment, surrounded by talented colleagues who are passionate about making a difference.
Additionally, you can expect:

Flexible working arrangements to help you balance your professional and personal life.
Opportunities to participate in impactful projects that shape the future of banking.
A culture that values diversity, inclusion, and sustainability.
At ABN AMRO, your growth is our priority, and together, we’ll achieve great things!

Bernard.Knaapen@nl.abnamro.com

title: Data engineer (focus op LLM)
description:
In het kort
Ben jij een IT-engineer en een enthousiaste persoonlijkheid die anderen inspireert om innovatieve oplossingen te creëren? Dan hebben we jouw hulp nodig om van ABN AMRO een persoonlijke bank te maken in een digitaal tijdperk!Hoe ga jij innovatie, vooruitgang en projecten binnen jouw afdeling vormgeven? Onze medewerkers krijgen de vrijheid om te groeien en te experimenteren. Jij ondersteunt en begeleidt hen, zodat zij zich kunnen ontwikkelen tot technische experts die bijdragen aan een toekomstbestendige bank. Wij werken hybride, wat betekent dat jij en je team flexibel kunnen bepalen waar en wanneer jullie het meest comfortabel en effectief kunnen werken.Al met al betekent werken bij ABN AMRO dat je bijdraagt aan projecten die ertoe doen en impact hebben op miljoenen klanten! Ben jij klaar voor de uitdaging?
Je werk
Je wordt onderdeel van een team dat zich specifiek richt op toekomstbestendige technologieën en frameworks om de strategie en initiatieven van de bank te versnellen. In deze rol ga je modellen ontwerpen, ontwikkelen en implementeren die andere teams ondersteunen. Ook ga je werken aan de applicatie die andere de mogelijkheid biedt om te werken met AI modellen. De Document and Data Capture-applicatie classificeert en haalt gegevens uit documenten. Deze gegevens worden gebruikt voor verdere verwerking. Daarnaast vormen deze gegevens de basis van de AI-layer, die mogelijkheden biedt voor diverse use cases, zoals ‘Talk to your document’ en andere nieuwe proposities. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het ontwikkelen en beoordelen van softwareoplossingen die worden ingezet in de Azure Cloud met behulp van uiteenlopende technologieën, zoals Document Intelligence, AI search en OpenAI. Je maakt deel uit van een divers Agile/Scrum DevOps-team en hebt end-to-end verantwoordelijkheid voor het ontwikkelen, beheren en onderhouden van functionaliteiten binnen het Enterprise Content Management-grid.
Werkomgeving
Bij ABN AMRO streven we ernaar om een persoonlijke bank te zijn in een digitaal tijdperk. Die strategie brengen we ook tot leven in de manier waarop we werken. Daarom bieden we hybride werken als de nieuwe norm. Dit geeft jou de flexibiliteit om te bepalen wanneer en waar je het meest comfortabel en effectief kunt werken. Natuurlijk bieden we je de juiste middelen om een goede thuiswerkplek in te richten. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan een ergonomische stoel, bureau en laptop.
Je profiel
Je voelt je helemaal thuis in een technische omgeving en bent altijd op de hoogte van de nieuwste technologieën. Bovendien ben je een goede communicator (in het Nederlands en Engels) en ben je gewend aan een agile/scrum-werkwijze. Denk je dat je bij ons past? Bekijk je profiel en solliciteer als je jezelf (gedeeltelijk) herkent in de volgende vereiste vaardigheden:
Ervaring met GenAI (LLM, RAG)
Ervaring met werken met cloudtechnologieën
Ervaring met Java/Kotlin en Python
Affiniteit met data science
De Nederlandse taal machtig
Wij bieden
Wij vinden het belangrijk om een goede werkgever te zijn. Bij ons werken betekent een rol met impact vervullen, ondersteund door uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden die jouw werkplezier, ontwikkeling en welzijn bevorderen. Daarnaast bieden wij:
Een aantrekkelijk bruto maandsalaris op basis van een 36-urige werkweek, inclusief vakantietoeslag en een flexibel budget voor arbeidsvoorwaarden. Afhankelijk van je vaardigheden en ervaring bieden wij een salaris in Hay 8, 9 of 10.
Een uitstekende pensioenregeling, zodat je goed voorbereid bent op de toekomst.
Flexibiliteit in werken: thuiswerken is mogelijk in overleg met je team en afhankelijk van je rol. Wij zorgen voor een ergonomische thuiswerkplek voor jou.
Ruimte voor ontspanning met vijf weken vakantie per jaar, aangevuld met twee verplichte vrije dagen. Daarnaast kun je tot vier extra weken vakantie per jaar bijkopen.
Vijf “Banking for better-days”: extra vrije dagen die je kunt gebruiken voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling of vrijwilligerswerk.
Persoonlijke ontwikkeling staat centraal: je ontvangt een ontwikkelingsbudget van €1.000 per jaar, dat kan oplopen tot €3.000.
Een jaarlijks openbaar vervoersabonnement waarmee je gratis kunt reizen door heel Nederland, zowel zakelijk als privé.Meer informatie over onze arbeidsvoorwaarden en salarisschalen vind je in onze Collectieve Arbeidsovereenkomst (CAO), die van toepassing is op deze vacature.
Interesse?
Ben je geïnteresseerd? Reageer dan online op deze vacature. Voor meer informatie kun je contact opnemen met Hans Kramers (Chapter Lead Data) via hans.kramers@nl.abnamro.com. We horen we graag van je!
Jouw Toekomst: Inclusief, Innovatief en Duurzaam
Bij ABN AMRO geloven we in "Banking for better, for generations to come." Gelijke kansen voor iedereen vormen een belangrijk fundament, waarbij we streven naar een inclusieve cultuur waarin alle medewerkers zich gezien, gehoord en gewaardeerd voelen. Onze visie als persoonlijke bank in de digitale tijd sluit naadloos aan bij de behoefte aan verrassende inzichten en innovatieve oplossingen, voortkomend uit een divers samenspel van culturen en ervaringen. We richten ons op klantbeleving, duurzaamheid en bouwen aan een toekomstbestendige bank, waarbij we gelijke beloning voor gelijk werk jaarlijks onderzoeken om eerlijke kansen te waarborgen. Sluit je aan bij een bank die vindingrijkheid en ambitie omarmt, en maak samen met ons impact voor een betere toekomst.
Als je wilt solliciteren voor het B-Able of Reboot programma, zorg er dan voor dat je dit vermeldt zowel in de titel als in de inhoud van je cv.
Disclaimer externe recruitmentbureaus
Externe recruitmentbureaus dienen een overeenkomst met ABN AMRO BANK N.V. te hebben getekend, uitgegeven door een Talent Acquisition Specialist, om cv's te mogen indienen. Acquisitie wordt daarom niet op prijs gesteld.

title: Business Developer AA & AI (Hay 11)

We are looking for a new team member! Our ideal candidate is a team player who combines good work ethics and results orientation with curiosity and adaptiveness, is willing to challenge the status quo and eager to take action to change it. And because we spend quite some time together as a team, a good sense of humour is appreciated.

Conduct interviews and workshops with stakeholders to understand business needs and challenges

Facilitate discussions to align stakeholders on improvement opportunities

Create clear and structured process documentation

Translate business needs into potential AI use cases
Collaborate with AI specialists to define solution direction
Stay informed on AI capabilities and innovations relevant to financial services

Assess impact of proposed improvements on efficiency, cost, and quality
Support prioritization of initiatives based on business value
Ensure solutions align with financial and regulatory context

Support implementation of new processes and ways of working
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives

The Finance & Risk Data Domain is part of Finance & Risk Business Grids (F&RBG), and plays an active role for all the Finance and Risk departments. We employ 200+ international professionals with different backgrounds who are driven to bring risk data management to a structurally higher level. Our aim is to generate reliable risk data on time. You have an interest and experience in AA & AI. You are a passionate, hard-working professional with an eye for details. You are able to execute assignments independently as well as interact directly with stakeholders when it comes to day-to-day matters.

You’ve successfully completed a higher professional education (Bsc.) or degree (Msc.) and have at least 5-7 years of relevant work experience
Experience with AI, automation, or digital transformation initiatives
Understanding of regulatory context in Finance & Risk
Experience working in cross-functional teams
Affinity with data-driven decision making
You are familiar with the Agile way of working
Excellent oral and written communication skills in English (Dutch is an advantage)
Experience with Confluence, JIRA or Azure Boards (pre).
A successful candidate will be required to demonstrate the following core competencies:
Structured thinking
Stakeholder management
Process improvement mindset
Interest in AI and innovation
Strong business understanding
Ability to connect business needs with technology opportunities
Excellent communication skills
Autonomy and self-starter
Data driven
Excellent skills in PowerPoint and Excel.
We are offering
A challenging environment offering you the possibility to develop yourself, both on contextual level in the Risk Management field of expertise, as well as managerial and leadership level. There are plenty of career opportunities to grow personally and professionally, which mainly depend on your own ambitions and interests.
In addition, we offer:
The Benefit Budget is 11% of your salary. The Benefit Budget allows you to acquire additional employment benefits. If you make no purchases or reservations in the Benefit Shop in a given month, you are paid one twelfth of your Benefit Budget that month.
Five weeks of vacation per year. You have the option to purchase an additional four weeks per year.

Possibility to work from home (in consultation with your team and depending on your position).
An annual public transport pass with free public transportation throughout the Netherlands.
An excellent pension scheme.

Implemented iFEM tool for navy applications be able to reconstruct displacement and stress/strain fields for a loading condition for a given geometry.

title: Internship | LLM-driven decision making in navy operations
description:
About this position
Tactical decision making in military operations depends heavily on the quality and completeness of information available to commanders and analysts before and during an operation. In the early stages of mission planning, the operational situation is often vague and ill-defined, yet this is precisely when the right background information needs to be identified and assembled. Large Language Models (LLMs) offer promising capabilities for supporting analysts and decision makers, but their effectiveness depends on being provided with the right contextual data; data that must be gathered and curated before the operation begins.
There is a need for intelligent methods that help determine what information is relevant to a given operational context, especially when initial descriptions of the situation are incomplete or ambiguous. Query expansion, the process of enriching an initial information need with related terms, concepts, and material, is a well-established technique in information retrieval that can address this challenge. By broadening and refining an initial query, query expansion can help surface documents, datasets, and knowledge sources that would otherwise be overlooked, effectively bridging the gap between a vague situational description and the comprehensive information base required for sound decision making.
This challenge is particularly relevant in scenarios where access to data is limited or fragmented, as is common in expeditionary and marine operations. In such settings, analysts cannot rely on having a complete, pre-structured information environment. Instead, they need tools that can proactively identify and retrieve relevant material from heterogeneous sources based on partial or evolving operational descriptions.
What will be your role?
In this Master's thesis internship, you will work on developing and evaluating query expansion techniques tailored to the military pre-operational planning context. You will investigate how an initial, potentially vague, operational description can be systematically expanded to retrieve relevant documents and data sources that can subsequently be provided to an LLM for mission support. This includes exploring techniques such as semantic query expansion using embeddings, knowledge-graph-based enrichment, and relevance feedback mechanisms. You will build upon existing retrieval and NLP tooling and evaluate your approach against realistic information needs derived from operational planning scenarios. You will have to work on finding existing context in the military domain that can be used as a starting point for this task
